description: Clarify v3 (docs/DESIGN-CLARIFY-v3.md): one stage per factory run clarify. The interviewer reads the user's words back (and later redirects, and free-form sheet answers); the researchers (repo, docs) run once per research pass, time-boxed and pinned to the confirmed versions, and the brief writer turns their findings into decision records; the contract writer writes the contract, and again in automatic fix rounds while God Eye's objections shrink (cli/core/loop.js); God Eye answers the fixed readiness checklist, and diagnoses a loop that stopped making progress; the finding-verifier settles an objection God Eye raises again after the writer had its fix. Every rule is cli/core/clarify.js's; the workflow only dispatches.
